name: Qingdao East Steel Tower Stock Co.Ltd
summary: Qingdao East Steel Tower Stock Co.Ltd, established in 1982 and headquartered in Jiaozhou, China, is a Chinese enterprise dedicated to manufacturing and marketing diverse steel structural components throughout the People's Republic of China. Their comprehensive portfolio caters to a wide array of industries. They supply industrial essentials such as boiler steel supports, pipe racks, and torch towers. They also fabricate structural steel for workshops, air cooling platforms in power plants, and substantial substation projects. For infrastructure development, the company designs and produces high-voltage transmission line towers, large-span towers, and a full spectrum of communication and broadcast towers, encompassing radio, television, microwave, and mobile telecommunication towers. Furthermore, their capabilities extend to structural elements for a variety of constructions, including high-rise buildings, sports stadiums, exhibition halls, industrial facilities, seismic-resistant structures, bridges, and maritime vessels. The company also contributes to urban landscapes with municipal bridges, traffic infrastructure, observation towers, water towers, sizable billboards, and street light poles. Beyond structures, they also produce specialized machinery for steel fabrication, such as H-beam production lines, beam boxing machines, and intersection line cutting systems. Their products are extensively utilized across critical sectors like petrochemicals, electric power generation, radio and television broadcasting, telecommunications, general building construction, and municipal infrastructure, among others.
